_comment: Renders both screens from recorded-shape Sonarr v4 / Radarr v5 calendar payloads for made-up shows and movies, seeded through the mock cache under the keys update() reads, so no request is made. The artwork is synthetic (gradient posters, plain-text logos) and also comes from the cache, where the plugin keeps every downloaded image; 'Night Shift Diaries' has no artwork, to exercise the text-only fallback, and 'The Orchard Kings' has a poster but no logo. The URLs point at 127.0.0.1:9 so a cache miss is refused at once rather than reaching a network. Frozen at 18:00 UTC on Mon 2026-11-16 so the relative dates (Today, Tmrw, Thu) are stable. The scroll variant keeps the ticker path crash- and bounds-checked; the text variant covers image_type none with the long episode format; the setup variant renders the no-sources screen.
